page.layout: One block only: a full-page title card, centred. No columns, no margins, no notes. Digitiser's banner ("Digitized by Google") at the foot is excluded.
page.notes: The title is set on a decorative blue cross-hatched background, a digitiser's cover image rather than a title page. The last title line ends in "..." as printed. The author's name is printed in a smaller, lighter face below a rule; the spelling "Turrettini" is as shown. The "Digitized by Google" logo is a digitiser's mark and is not transcribed. This is a cover of the digitised volume, not the printed title page itself, so the full title and imprint are not visible here.
